metadata.description: Skills for notella — handwritten note intelligence on your own machine.

plugins.name: notella
plugins.description: The notella pipeline: 19 Claude skills that turn photographed handwritten notebook pages in ~/notella/ into transcripts, structure, actions, daily/weekly/monthly/project syntheses with memory of their predecessors, longitudinal theme snapshots with deltas, ledgers (decisions, commitments, people) and a human verdict loop (notella-review). Operates the local notella-state facility; pairs with notella-desktop.
